meta.description: Workflow MVP minimo: consulta offers.v_offer_ranking_current, monta mensagem, valida allowlist e registra offers.publication_events. Credenciais reais devem ser configuradas no painel do n8n.

parameters.jsCode:
const item = $json;
const sqlText = (value) => value === null || value === undefined ? 'null' : `'${String(value).replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
const sqlNumber = (value) => value === null || value === undefined || value === '' || Number.isNaN(Number(value)) ? 'null' : String(Number(value));
const sqlJson = (value) => `${sqlText(JSON.stringify(value))}::jsonb`;
const payload = {
  run_id: item.run_id,
  dry_run: item.dry_run,
  target_allowed: item.target_allowed,
  blocked_reason: item.blocked_reason,
  send_result: item.send_result,
  score_reasons: item.score_reasons,
  rank_profile: item.rank_profile,
  rank_subniche: item.rank_subniche,
  adapter_status: item.adapter_status,
  adapter_message_id: item.adapter_message_id,
  adapter_ack: item.adapter_ack,
  adapter_response_type: item.adapter_response_type,
};
const upsertQuery = `insert into offers.publication_events (
  profile,
  marketplace,
  stable_key,
  item_id,
  target,
  channel_adapter,
  delivery_status,
  manifest_item_number,
  artifact_generated_at,
  manifest_created_at,
  planned_at,
  sent_at,
  offer_title,
  offer_url,
  offer_price,
  message_text,
  payload
)
values (
  ${sqlText(item.profile)},
  ${sqlText(item.marketplace)},
  ${sqlText(item.stable_key)},
  ${sqlNumber(item.item_id)},
  ${sqlText(item.target)},
  ${sqlText(item.channel_adapter)},
  ${sqlText(item.delivery_status)},
  ${sqlNumber(item.manifest_item_number)},
  ${sqlText(item.artifact_generated_at)}::timestamptz,
  ${sqlText(item.manifest_created_at)}::timestamptz,
  null,
  ${sqlText(item.sent_at)}::timestamptz,
  ${sqlText(item.product_name)},
  ${sqlText(item.offer_link)},
  ${sqlNumber(item.price)},
  ${sqlText(item.message_text)},
  ${sqlJson(payload)}
)
on conflict (profile, target, manifest_item_number, artifact_generated_at)
do update
set delivery_status = excluded.delivery_status,
    sent_at = excluded.sent_at,
    message_text = excluded.message_text,
    payload = excluded.payload,
    updated_at = now()
returning publish_id;`;
return { json: { ...item, publication_event_upsert_query: upsertQuery } };
